text:
marta: hitting a weird ESM/CJS + bundler interop issue in our JS SDK when bundled for edge. quick repro in sample app.

marta: Repro steps i used: clone sampleapp-edge-bundler-repro, yarn, set RW_KEY, yarn build:ssr:edge (vite ssr target=webworker), then run worker shim and POST to /api/generate.

marta: Error on runtime: TypeError: RedwoodSDK.default is not a constructor (sometimes RedwoodSDK is undefined). Only with production bundler builds (vite/rollup/webpack targeting edge). dev server is fine.

akshay: sounds like conditional exports resolution + interop wrapper. our package.json has exports import/require fields. bundlers and our build helpers each add different shims (.default wrappers etc).

jamie: can you paste the top of the built bundle where the import happens? is it using require() or import?

marta: snippet from dist server bundle: ```
var redwood_sdk = __toCommonJS(require('redwood-sdk'))
const sdk = new redwood_sdk(); // crashes here
```

marta: switching to `import * as SDK` changes error to `SDK.Client is not a constructor`. clearly export shape mismatch.

tasha: which bundlers reproduce? vite only? rollup? webpack?

marta: reproduced on Vite (ssr build), Rollup, and Webpack 5 (webworker target). each produces slightly different export shapes but same root cause at runtime on edge.

noah: also noticed a secondary problem: SDK retry wrapper sometimes strips Authorization on retry attempts in edge. logs show initial request has Authorization header, retry does not.

akshay: that's a common pitfall: naive retry code does `new Request(orig.url, { method: orig.method })` which drops headers/body. and instanceof Request checks can fail in bundled environments causing fallback code paths.

marta: here's the problematic code (from node_modules/redwood-sdk/dist/esm/fetch-retry.js, reformatted):
```js
export async function sendWithRetry(originalReq) {
  try {
    return await fetch(originalReq)
  } catch (err) {
    // naive re-create: loses headers/body
    const r = new Request(originalReq.url, { method: originalReq.method })
    return await fetch(r)
  }
}
```

jamie: for a quick check, try forcing the ESM entry in the sample app: `import SDK from 'redwood-sdk/dist/esm/index.js'` and rebuild. if that changes the error it's conditional exports resolution.

marta: pointing directly to dist/esm/index.js changes the failure (now missing global polyfill dependency), so ESM build loads but we hit transitive assumption (global fetch/kv). bundler sometimes removes polyfills in prod builds.

tasha: common workarounds: ship a single canonical ESM entry and document/bundle a tiny CJS shim for older consumers, or ensure exports map includes browser/worker keys. also fix retry to properly clone headers/body (Request.clone() or copy headers explicitly).

noah: webpack oddity: the build only fails when `optimization.moduleIds = 'named'`; with `deterministic` it works. means webpack id naming and interop helpers affect export shape. worth noting in repro.

jamie: minimal local repro steps for others:
1) git clone sampleapp-edge-bundler-repro
2) cp .env.example .env (set RW_KEY)
3) yarn && yarn build:ssr:edge (vite build --ssr --target=webworker)
4) node ./tools/edge-simulate.js --bundle ./dist/server-edge.js
post curl to /api/generate and inspect logs.

marta: i added a `repros/conditional-exports-edge/` folder in sampleapp with a README, the three bundler configs and a tiny script that reports the sampled export shapes for the SDK (console.log of import result).

akshay: plan: 1) fix retry (preserve headers/body) 2) add integration tests for edge clone behavior 3) update packaging to make ESM path unambiguous (exports.browser/worker pointing to ESM) and include short interop shim.

tasha: can you open a PR with those changes + a note in sampleapp README about bundler quirks? we can land fast.

marta: opening PR now on branch `marta/repro-bundler-edge`. adding repro artifacts and suggested SDK patch.

devx-bot: CI: edge-target job failed, see job 4523 logs: https://ci/internal/jobs/4523

noah: I'll add a CI matrix job to run the repro across vite/rollup/webpack so we catch regressions. ticket OPS-827.

akshay: i'll draft the SDK changes (retry clone + packaging) and add changelog note about improved edge retry behavior.

jamie: after patch, add devx docs note about bundler + conditional exports + edge runtime traps. good to have for SDK consumers.

marta: thanks all, PR posted: https://git.internal/p/redwood/sdk/pulls/1234 (WIP), will update with test and CI changes shortly.
